subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Sustainable Raw Materials
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Sustainable Raw Materials.

hook.text: Palm oil is in 50% of supermarket products. Its production destroys rainforests. Can we source it responsibly?

buildup.text: Sustainable sourcing selects raw materials produced with minimal environmental and social harm.

discovery.text: Certifications like FSC for wood, MSC for fish, and RSPO for palm oil verify responsible practices.

twist.text: Certification costs money and time. Small farmers in developing countries often can't afford it.

climax.text: Companies that invest in sustainable sourcing protect their supply long-term as resources become scarcer.

punchline.text: Source responsibly now or lose the resource entirely later.
